g.title: G
No window timer. Meaning: The validator has not started the timer for this window. Purpose: The first ParentReady event supplies the reference time for leader progress.

Wait for the first data set. Meaning: Agave waits for the first-data deadline after ParentReady. The formula includes production time and a network-delay allowance. Purpose: The validator must give an honest leader time to send data before it treats the leader as silent.
g.text: Wait for the first data set

g.title: T01: First ParentReady. When: The validator gets the first ParentReady event for this window. Action: Set the first-data and block deadlines. Reason: The event establishes when the validator can start to expect progress from this leader window.

a.xlink:title: The event establishes when the validator can start to expect progress from this leader window.
T01: First ParentReady

g.title: Wait for the block deadline. Meaning: The timer tracks slot i. Each subsequent slot gets one additional block interval. Purpose: The vote handler checks whether a complete, usable block arrived before the relevant deadline.

T02: First-data deadline. When: The first-data deadline expires. Action: Advance the timer machine to the first block deadline. Reason: The validator must next find whether a complete block arrived in time.

a.xlink:title: The validator must next find whether a complete block arrived in time.
T02: First-data deadline

g.title: First-data timeout event. Meaning: TimeoutCrashedLeader tells the vote handler that the first-data deadline has passed. Purpose: The handler still checks for a first shred and an existing vote before it sends skips.

T03: Emit first-data event. When: The timer leaves the first-data wait state. Action: Emit TimeoutCrashedLeader for the first slot. Reason: This event lets the vote handler check whether the leader has supplied any shred.

a.xlink:title: This event lets the vote handler check whether the leader has supplied any shred.
T03: Emit first-data event

g.title: T05: More slots remain. When: A block deadline expires and another slot remains in the window. Action: Advance i by one. Add one block interval to the deadline. Reason: Each successive block needs its own production interval.

a.xlink:title: Each successive block needs its own production interval.
T05: More slots remain

g.title: Window timers complete. Meaning: The last block deadline in this window has passed. Purpose: This timer machine has no more slots to check. Other windows and certificate processing continue independently.
T06: Last deadline. When: The last block deadline in the window expires. Action: Finish this window’s timer machine. Reason: There are no further slots to check in this window.

a.xlink:title: There are no further slots to check in this window.
T06: Last deadline

g.title: Block timeout event. Meaning: Timeout(i) tells the vote handler that this block’s deadline has passed. Purpose: The event can cause an initial skip only while the validator has no first vote for i.
T04: Emit block event. When: The deadline for block i expires. Action: Emit Timeout(i). Reason: The vote handler must decide whether to stop its initial-vote wait for this slot.

a.xlink:title: The vote handler must decide whether to stop its initial-vote wait for this slot.
T04: Emit block event

g.title: Check for silence. Meaning: The first slot must have neither a first vote nor a received first shred for this test to pass. Purpose: A first shred shows some data progress. An existing first vote must stay unchanged.
g.text: AND no first shred for w?

g.title: T07: Check first data. When: The vote handler receives TimeoutCrashedLeader. Action: Check for an existing first vote and a first shred. Reason: The handler must not treat a leader as silent when it already has data or a vote for the slot.

a.xlink:title: The handler must not treat a leader as silent when it already has data or a vote for the slot.
T07: Check first data

g.title: Check whether the first vote is open. Meaning: The validator checks whether it has sent NotarVote or SkipVote for this slot. Purpose: An ordinary timeout cannot change an existing first vote.

T08: Check first vote. When: The vote handler receives Timeout(i). Action: Check whether the validator has a first vote for i. Reason: The deadline can cause an initial skip only if the initial decision is still open.

a.xlink:title: The deadline can cause an initial skip only if the initial decision is still open.
T08: Check first vote

g.title: Skip the unvoted slots. Meaning: trySkipWindow sends an initial SkipVote for each slot in this window that has no first vote. Purpose: This helps the network reach another leader window. It preserves first votes that the validator already sent.
g.text: for every slot in this window

g.title: T09: No vote and no shred. When: The first-data deadline passed. No first vote or first shred exists for the first slot. Action: Run trySkipWindow. Reason: The validator has no data evidence of progress and can help the network proceed to another window.

a.xlink:title: The validator has no data evidence of progress and can help the network proceed to another window.
T09: No vote and no shred
a.text: T09: No vote and no shred

g.title: No skip action from this event. Meaning: The handler keeps the existing vote state because the timeout’s skip condition is false. Purpose: The validator must respect an existing vote. The first-data event also cannot treat a received shred as silence.
g.text: Send no skip vote from this event

g.title: T11: Vote or shred exists. When: The validator already has a first vote or a first shred for the slot. Action: Send no skip vote from this event. Reason: An existing vote must remain fixed. A first shred makes the silence check insufficient, so the block deadline controls the later decision.

a.xlink:title: An existing vote must remain fixed. A first shred makes the silence check insufficient, so the block deadline controls the later decision.
T11: Vote or shred exists

g.title: T10: No first vote. When: The block deadline passed. The slot has no first vote. Action: Run trySkipWindow. Reason: The validator did not get a block it could support before its deadline.

a.xlink:title: The validator did not get a block it could support before its deadline.
T10: No first vote

g.title: T12: First vote exists. When: The validator already sent a first vote for this slot. Action: Keep that first vote. Reason: A timeout cannot authorize a second initial vote.

a.xlink:title: A timeout cannot authorize a second initial vote.
T12: First vote exists
